mapper.select: /*menu.selectMenus*/ SELECT MENU.MENU_ID AS MENUID , MENU.UPPER_ID AS UPPERID , MENU.NAME , MENU.DEPTH , MENU.TYPE , AUTH.AUTH_ID AS AUTHID , MENU.URL , MENU.MENU_ORDER AS MENUORDER , MENU.MENU_DC AS MENUDC , MENU.CREATE_DT AS CREATEDT , DECODE(SUBSTR(MENU.MENU_ID, 0, 1), 'b', 'b00100000000', DECODE(MENU.DEPTH, 0,MENU.MENU_ID, 1,MENU.MENU_ID, 2,MENU.UPPER_ID, 3,(SELECT UPPER_ID FROM KX_MENUINFO WHERE MENU_ID = MENU.UPPER_ID), 4,(SELECT UPPER_ID FROM KX_MENUINFO WHERE MENU_ID = MENU.UPPER_ID) )) AS TOPMENUID , NVL(MENU.ROLE_ID,'N') AS ROLEID FROM KX_MENUINFO MENU , KX_MENUAUTH AUTH WHERE MENU.MENU_ID = AUTH.MENU_ID AND NVL(MENU.USE_FLAG, 'Y') != 'N' AND NVL(AUTH.USE_FLAG, 'Y') != 'N' ORDER BY MENU.DEPTH ASC , MENU.MENU_ORDER ASC

/*menu.selectMenus2*/ SELECT MENU.MENU_ID AS MENUID , MENU.UPPER_ID AS UPPERID , MENU.NAME , MENU.DEPTH , MENU.TYPE , AUTH.AUTH_ID AS AUTHID , MENU.URL , MENU.MENU_ORDER AS MENUORDER , MENU.MENU_DC AS MENUDC , MENU.CREATE_DT AS CREATEDT , DECODE(SUBSTR(MENU.MENU_ID, 0, 1), 'b', 'b00100000000', DECODE(MENU.DEPTH, 0,MENU.MENU_ID, 1,MENU.MENU_ID, 2,MENU.UPPER_ID, 3,(SELECT UPPER_ID FROM KX_MENUINFO WHERE MENU_ID = MENU.UPPER_ID), 4,(SELECT UPPER_ID FROM KX_MENUINFO WHERE MENU_ID = MENU.UPPER_ID) )) AS TOPMENUID , NVL(MENU.ROLE_ID,'N') AS ROLEID FROM KX_MENUINFO MENU , KX_MENUAUTH AUTH WHERE MENU.MENU_ID = AUTH.MENU_ID AND AUTH.AUTH_ID = #{AUTH_ID} AND NVL(MENU.USE_FLAG, 'Y') != 'N' AND NVL(AUTH.USE_FLAG, 'Y') != 'N' AND MENU.MENU_ID NOT LIKE 'sr%' AND MENU.MENU_ID NOT LIKE 'br%' ORDER BY MENU.DEPTH ASC , MENU.MENU_ORDER ASC

/*menu.selectMenus3*/ SELECT MENU.MENU_ID AS MENUID , MENU.UPPER_ID AS UPPERID , MENU.NAME , MENU.DEPTH , MENU.TYPE , AUTH.AUTH_ID AS AUTHID , MENU.URL , MENU.MENU_ORDER AS MENUORDER , MENU.MENU_DC AS MENUDC , MENU.CREATE_DT AS CREATEDT , DECODE(SUBSTR(MENU.MENU_ID, 0, 1), 'b', 'b00100000000', DECODE(MENU.DEPTH, 0,MENU.MENU_ID, 1,MENU.MENU_ID, 2,MENU.UPPER_ID, 3,(SELECT UPPER_ID FROM KX_MENUINFO WHERE MENU_ID = MENU.UPPER_ID), 4,(SELECT UPPER_ID FROM KX_MENUINFO WHERE MENU_ID = MENU.UPPER_ID) )) AS TOPMENUID , NVL(MENU.ROLE_ID,'N') AS ROLEID FROM KX_MENUINFO MENU , KX_MENUAUTH AUTH WHERE MENU.MENU_ID = AUTH.MENU_ID AND AUTH.AUTH_ID = #{AUTH_ID} AND NVL(MENU.USE_FLAG, 'Y') != 'N' AND NVL(AUTH.USE_FLAG, 'Y') != 'N' AND MENU.MENU_ID NOT LIKE 'sr%' AND MENU.MENU_ID NOT LIKE 'br%' AND MENU.UPPER_ID != 'm00201090000' ORDER BY MENU.DEPTH ASC , MENU.MENU_ORDER ASC

/*menu.selectMenus2_v2*/ SELECT MENU.MENU_ID AS MENUID , MENU.UPPER_ID AS UPPERID , MENU.NAME , MENU.DEPTH , MENU.TYPE , AUTH.AUTH_ID AS AUTHID , MENU.URL , MENU.MENU_ORDER AS MENUORDER , MENU.MENU_DC AS MENUDC , MENU.CREATE_DT AS CREATEDT , DECODE(SUBSTR(MENU.MENU_ID, 0, 1), 'b', 'b00100000000', DECODE(MENU.DEPTH, 0,MENU.MENU_ID, 1,MENU.MENU_ID, 2,MENU.UPPER_ID, 3,(SELECT UPPER_ID FROM KX_MENUINFO WHERE MENU_ID = MENU.UPPER_ID), 4,(SELECT UPPER_ID FROM KX_MENUINFO WHERE MENU_ID = MENU.UPPER_ID) )) AS TOPMENUID , NVL(MENU.ROLE_ID,'N') AS ROLEID FROM KX_MENUINFO MENU , KX_MENUAUTH AUTH WHERE MENU.MENU_ID = AUTH.MENU_ID AND AUTH.AUTH_ID = #{AUTH_ID} AND NVL(MENU.USE_FLAG, 'Y') != 'N' AND NVL(AUTH.USE_FLAG, 'Y') != 'N' AND (MENU.MENU_ID LIKE 'sr%' OR MENU.MENU_ID LIKE 'br%') ORDER BY MENU.MENU_ID , MENU.MENU_ORDER ASC,MENU.DEPTH ASC

/*menu.selectMenus3_v2*/ SELECT MENU.MENU_ID AS MENUID , MENU.UPPER_ID AS UPPERID , MENU.NAME , MENU.DEPTH , MENU.TYPE , AUTH.AUTH_ID AS AUTHID , MENU.URL , MENU.MENU_ORDER AS MENUORDER , MENU.MENU_DC AS MENUDC , MENU.CREATE_DT AS CREATEDT , DECODE(SUBSTR(MENU.MENU_ID, 0, 1), 'b', 'b00100000000', DECODE(MENU.DEPTH, 0,MENU.MENU_ID, 1,MENU.MENU_ID, 2,MENU.UPPER_ID, 3,(SELECT UPPER_ID FROM KX_MENUINFO WHERE MENU_ID = MENU.UPPER_ID), 4,(SELECT UPPER_ID FROM KX_MENUINFO WHERE MENU_ID = MENU.UPPER_ID) )) AS TOPMENUID , NVL(MENU.ROLE_ID,'N') AS ROLEID FROM KX_MENUINFO MENU , KX_MENUAUTH AUTH WHERE MENU.MENU_ID = AUTH.MENU_ID AND AUTH.AUTH_ID = #{AUTH_ID} AND NVL(MENU.USE_FLAG, 'Y') != 'N' AND NVL(AUTH.USE_FLAG, 'Y') != 'N' AND MENU.UPPER_ID != 'm00201090000' AND (MENU.MENU_ID LIKE 'sr%' OR MENU.MENU_ID LIKE 'br%') ORDER BY MENU.MENU_ID , MENU.MENU_ORDER ASC,MENU.DEPTH ASC

/*menu.selecLefttMenus*/ SELECT MENU.MENU_ID AS MENUID , MENU.UPPER_ID AS UPPERID , MENU.NAME , MENU.DEPTH , MENU.TYPE , AUTH.AUTH_ID AS AUTHID , MENU.URL , MENU.MENU_ORDER AS MENUORDER , MENU.MENU_DC AS MENUDC , MENU.CREATE_DT AS CREATEDT , DECODE(MENU.DEPTH, 0,MENU.MENU_ID, 1,MENU.MENU_ID, 2,MENU.UPPER_ID, 3,(SELECT UPPER_ID FROM KX_MENUINFO WHERE MENU_ID = MENU.UPPER_ID), 4,(SELECT UPPER_ID FROM KX_MENUINFO WHERE MENU_ID = MENU.UPPER_ID) ) TOPMENUID FROM KX_MENUINFO MENU , KX_MENUAUTH AUTH WHERE MENU.MENU_ID = AUTH.MENU_ID AND NVL(MENU.USE_FLAG, 'Y') != 'N' AND NVL(AUTH.USE_FLAG, 'Y') != 'N' AND AUTH.AUTH_ID = #{value} ORDER BY MENU.DEPTH ASC , MENU.MENU_ORDER ASC

/*menu.selectMenusForSecurity*/ SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN MENU.TYPE = 'tab' THEN NVL ( SUBSTR (MENU.URL, INSTR (MENU.URL, ',"') + 2, LENGTH (MENU.URL) - INSTR (MENU.URL, ',"') - 3), '#') ELSE NVL(MENU.URL,'#') END AS URL, AUTH.AUTH_ID AS AUTHID FROM KX_MENUINFO MENU, KX_MENUAUTH AUTH WHERE MENU.MENU_ID = AUTH.MENU_ID AND MENU.USE_FLAG = 'Y' AND AUTH.USE_FLAG = 'Y'

/*menu.selectMenuByMenuId*/ SELECT MENU.MENU_ID AS MENUID , MENU.UPPER_ID AS UPPERID , MENU.NAME , MENU.DEPTH , MENU.TYPE , AUTH.AUTH_ID AS AUTHID , MENU.URL , MENU.MENU_ORDER AS MENUORDER , MENU.MENU_DC AS MENUDC , MENU.CREATE_DT AS CREATEDT , SUBSTR(MENU.UPPER_ID,0,4)||'000' AS TOPMENUID FROM KX_MENUINFO MENU , KX_MENUAUTH AUTH WHERE MENU.MENU_ID = AUTH.MENU_ID AND NVL(MENU.USE_FLAG, 'Y') != 'N' AND NVL(AUTH.USE_FLAG, 'Y') != 'N' AND MENU.MENU_ID = #{menuId}
mapper.update: INSERT INTO KX_MENUINFO (MENU_ID, UPPER_ID, NAME, DEPTH, TYPE, AUTH_ID, URL, MENU_ORDER, MENU_DC, CREATE_DT) VALUES (#{menuId}, #{upperId}, #{name}, #{depth}, #{type}, #{authId}, #{url}, #{menuOrder}, #{menuDc}, sysdate)
mapper.select:
/*getMainCateList_v2*/ SELECT A.STD_CATEG_ID -- 카테고리번호[0] , A.CATEG_NAME --[1] , A.CATEG_NAME CATEG_NAME_REAL , A.CATEG_TYPE --[2] , A.CATEG_SYS_CODE , A.PID , A.DEPTH , DECODE ( A.CATEG_TYPE, 'REG', '', ' (' || (SELECT COUNT (DISTINCT C.BUYER_ITEM_NO) FROM ICOMBYIT B, ICOMCQDT C WHERE B.BUYER = C.BUYER AND B.BUYER_ITEM_NO = C.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND B.STATUS <> 'D' AND C.STATUS <> 'D' AND B.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG IN ('N', 'Y') AND C.BELOW_COMORG_CODE = DECODE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'M180' AND FLAG = 'Y' AND CODE = #{param4}), 0, #{param4}, C.BELOW_COMORG_CODE) AND B.BUYER = A.COM_CODE AND B.CATEGORY_NO = A.STD_CATEG_ID) || ')') AS CNT --[3] FROM ICOMBYCA A WHERE A.COM_CODE = (SELECT DECODE(USING_CATAL_TYPE, 'A', BYCA_COMORG_CODE --A :전용 , 'C', BYCA_COMORG_CODE --C : 둘다 , 'KRCOMMG001' ) BYCA_COMORG_CODE --하드코딩 FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = #{param4} --param4 : 고객사 com_code )
AND A.DEPTH = #{param2} --param2
AND A.STATUS <> 'D'
AND A.PID = #{param3} --param3 : 선택한 카테고리
AND A.STD_CATEG_ID IN ( SELECT DISTINCT STD_CATEG_ID FROM ( SELECT STD_CATEG_ID FROM ICOMBYCA A, ICOMCOD3 B WHERE A.COM_CODE=B.BUYER AND A.COM_CODE = #{param1} AND A.COM_CODE = B.TEXT1 AND B.TYPE = #{type} AND B.CODE1 = #{param5} AND B.FLAG = 'Y' AND SUBSTR(A.CATEG_SYS_CODE,1,8) = B.TEXT2 UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT STD_CATEG_ID FROM ICOMBYCA A WHERE A.COM_CODE = #{param1} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ICOMCOD3 B WHERE B.BUYER = A.COM_CODE AND B.TEXT1 = A.COM_CODE AND B.TEXT2 = SUBSTR(A.CATEG_SYS_CODE,1,8) AND B.TYPE = #{type} AND B.FLAG = 'Y' ) ) )
ORDER BY A.CATEG_SYS_CODE
